verdict.rationale: Fellow documents its own export path: the Super Admin API can 'retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace' to back up notes and transcripts, and the REST API lists notes, recordings with diarized transcripts, and action items with pagination. Note content comes as GitHub-Flavored Markdown with Fellow extensions. However, workspace-wide export is limited to Enterprise-plan admins and is only reachable through the API, and the Markdown includes proprietary extensions. missing for 10: a self-serve bulk export (UI or archive download) for ordinary users, evidence that all data types including recording media can be exported, confirmation the formats are fully open rather than Fellow-extended Markdown, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export-and-leave workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes
The Developer API opens that data to you: transcripts, structured notes, and more, all available through standard REST calls.
Fellow Markdown is the format the API uses for reading and writing note content. It is GitHub-Flavored Markdown plus Fellow extensions
Each Recording is associated with a Note, and can contain information such as: Diarized and timestamped transcripts
